Name: Extremely Small Ocean Farm
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Are you looking for a challenge? Do you like extremely small things? Do you think you can achieve perfection by testing your limits? If the answer is yes, then this map is for you.

Extremely Small Ocean Farm is a cute farm overlooking the ocean, with a small stream running through it, it replaces the river farm, everything is diggable, on the beach you have both fodder and supply crates and also the farm It has blue grass.


There are 2 versions, both versions replace the River Farm, one has differentiated fish, from river to river and from ocean to ocean and the same goes for the crab pots, the other version has only fish from river.I worked hard and found this excellent solution.
I personally will use the one with the differentiated fish, but now you can choose.

Hey Pep! I've made some minor changes to the map, I'm playing with it, and I've optimized the spaces. For now only the differentiated fish
version, let me know if I need to edit the other version as well.

Have fun!

I thank in advance anyone who believes that my work deserves at least the time to give a thumbs up.

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]


If you appreciate my work could you buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?

Downloads.Description: This has only river fish everywhere and does not require EscaModdingPlugin mod. Added waterfall sound.
Fixed crab pots and graphical bug.
